metadataRaw.title: Best Exercises to Realign Your Spine
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the best exercises to quickly help realign the spine.

If you feel like something is off balance in your back, like you're tilting or leaning towards one side, definitely check this video out.

A major cause of this is due to muscle imbalances, such as tightness, that pulls the spine out of alignment.

The exercises in this video will help release this tightness, improving posture and alignment. 

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, try them all and use what works best for you.

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:39 Wall Lean
2:13 Seated Lean
4:15 Standing Puppy
6:11 Hip Hike
8:00 Bed Lean
